SELECT count(c.value) AS cnt, c.value AS typeCode, sc.name_ AS typeName,
#{areaId} AS areaId
c.areaId AS areaId
FROM ( SELECT a.id_, area.id_ AS areaId, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.opp_include_type, ',', b.help_topic_id + 1), ',', -1) AS value FROM topp_opportunity_base_view a LEFT JOIN help_topic b ON b.help_topic_id < (LENGTH(a.opp_include_type) - LENGTH(REPLACE(a.opp_include_type, ',', '')) + 1) LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON area.id_ = a.opp_area_id WHERE a.audit_time >= #{startDate} AND a.audit_status NOT IN ('opp_stop', 'opp_new', 'opp_notpass') AND a.opp_source != 'kssj' AND a.opp_area_id LIKE CONCAT(#{areaPrefix}, '%') ) c LEFT JOIN sys_code sc ON c.value = sc.code_ AND sc.type_ = 'opp_type' WHERE c.value != ''
GROUP BY c.value
GROUP BY c.value, c.areaId ORDER BY c.areaId ASC
